Overview → Outputs → Master Variables → Biostat Handoff → Estimands → Measure Semantics → Case Selection → Analysis Methods → Sensitivity Analyses → Multiplicity → Freeze Gates
rows.Execution Rule: Resolve every PENDING blocker before execution

rows.Decision: C1 cardiometabolic joint contrast and C2 COPD contrast
rows.Execution Rule: Report both with two-sided 97.5% CIs; secondary estimates use explicitly labeled 95% CIs

rows.Decision: OLS remains principal
rows.Execution Rule: Unweighted OLS with HC3; spatial-error is mandatory sensitivity only when Moran gate passes

rows.Decision: 9999 conditional random permutations; gate |Moran's I| ≥ 0.10 and P < .05
rows.Execution Rule: If spatial-error changes sign or magnitude by >20%, label model-sensitive and display both equally; never switch principal estimator

rows.Decision: Withhold if N <70, rank deficient, exposure has <10 distinct nonsuppressed values, convergence/covariance fails, or unresolved data error dominates
rows.Execution Rule: Report descriptive results and withholding reason only

rows.Decision: Annual observed-adult denominator, phenotype, suppression, deduplication, reliability, and annual persistence must be signed
rows.Execution Rule: Pooled measure is not unique-person 3-year prevalence

rows.Decision: Two scorers use fixed anchors and reconcile before outcome access
rows.Execution Rule: No life expectancy, mortality, linked residuals, maps, correlations, or P values

rows.Decision: Confirmatory model execution is prohibited
rows.Execution Rule: S4, S5, and signed S6 must all pass in sequence
rows.Owner / Evidence: Freeze Gates sheet and immutable approvals

Adults aged 18 years or older represented in CAPriCORN contributing systems
77 Chicago community areas; tracts descriptive/comparator only

rows.Decision: 2022-2024; 2019 baseline; 2020-2021 disruption

annexes.name: Estimands
annexes.title: Estimands and Interpretation
annexes.note: All contrasts are area-level adjusted associations and are noncausal. C1 and C2 form one confirmatory family.

rows.Exposure Contrast: Simultaneous 1-IQR increases in denominator-weighted annual hypertension and diabetes diagnosed proportions
rows.Summary / Method: βH×IQRH + βD×IQRD; variance includes full βH/βD covariance
rows.Confidence Interval: Two-sided 97.5% CI; nominal 95% CI only as labeled estimation context
rows.Allowed Interpretation: Associated difference in area life expectancy

rows.Exposure Contrast: 1-IQR increase in denominator-weighted annual COPD diagnosed proportion
rows.Summary / Method: Principal unweighted OLS contrast with HC3 uncertainty
rows.Confidence Interval: Two-sided 97.5% CI; nominal 95% CI only as labeled estimation context
rows.Allowed Interpretation: Associated difference in area life expectancy

rows.Exposure Contrast: 1-IQR hypertension increase conditional on diabetes and covariates
1-IQR diabetes increase conditional on hypertension and covariates

rows.Summary / Method: Spearman primary; Pearson, paired difference, quartiles/kappa supportive

annexes.name: Case Selection
annexes.title: Outcome-Blinded Case-Study Selection
annexes.note: Two blinded scorers apply fixed anchors independently, retain original scores, and reconcile before outcome access. No outcome information may be used.

rows.Hard Gate: ≥90% of 231 area-years usable and no year <85%

rows.Fixed Scoring Rule: 15 ≥90%; 12 for 80%-89.9%; 8 for 70%-79.9%; 4 for 60%-69.9%; hard fail <60% unless community-area-only predeclared
10 if median area rank correlation ≥0.80 and no discontinuity; 7 for 0.60-0.79; 3 below 0.60; 0 with unexplained discontinuity
rows.Required Evidence: Predictor-only annual ranks and denominator diagnostics

rows.Fixed Scoring Rule: 15 validated stable definition/exclusions; 10 stable diagnosis-only with documented sensitivity; 5 material coding ambiguity; hard fail unresolved
15 aligned crude adult comparator at tract and community-area levels; 10 one level; 5 materially different but interpretable; 0 none
rows.Hard Gate: Independent comparator or aligned supportive mortality construct

rows.Fixed Scoring Rule: 15 direct rationale plus search-bounded gap; 10 supportive rationale/gap; 5 crowded literature with limited distinct contribution; 0 no rationale
rows.Required Evidence: Frozen evidence matrix independent of outcomes

rows.Fixed Scoring Rule: 10 concrete FQHC/CBO questions supported by semantics; 5 general public-health relevance; 0 only speculative action claims
rows.Hard Gate: No unsupported intervention or outcome claim

rows.Fixed Scoring Rule: 5 different phenotype/ascertainment/reliability lesson; 2 partial overlap; 0 duplication
Hypertension and diabetes each pass and score ≥70; joint area-year usability ≥85%; predictor-only VIF <5
rows.Required Evidence: Component scores and predictor-only collinearity audit

rows.Fixed Scoring Rule: Promote passing cardiometabolic bundle; second nonduplicative candidate score ≥70. Tie-break: phenotype score, community usability, comparator alignment, portfolio distinctiveness, written adjudication

annexes.name: Analysis Methods
annexes.title: Primary Models and Decision Gates
annexes.note: OLS remains principal. No observed coefficient, P value, or visual result may switch the principal estimator.

rows.Primary Decision: Unweighted OLS; one row per community area; HC3 uncertainty; OLS remains principal
rows.Sensitivity / Withholding Rule: Withhold if N <70, rank deficient, covariance fails, or unresolved data error dominates
rows.Reporting: C1/C2 estimate and 97.5% CI; exact N

rows.Primary Decision: Age 65+, female if compatible, poverty, pooled capture; ≤6 nonintercept parameters
rows.Sensitivity / Withholding Rule: Pre-outcome consolidation or withhold; never significance-based deletion

rows.Diagnostic / Gate: Observed support; residual plots; ≥10 areas per spline parameter
rows.Sensitivity / Withholding Rule: Spline exploratory only; primary linear remains

rows.Primary Decision: Row-standardized queen weights; residual Global Moran's I; 9999 conditional random permutations
rows.Diagnostic / Gate: Mandatory spatial-error sensitivity if |Moran's I| ≥0.10 and permutation P <.05
rows.Sensitivity / Withholding Rule: Rook/connected distance weights; never replace OLS; sign change or >20% difference = model-sensitive
rows.Reporting: Seed, weights checksum, Moran statistic/expected/P; both model estimates equally when model-sensitive

rows.Sensitivity / Withholding Rule: Leave-one-area-out and exclude-all-flagged sensitivity; fragile if sign changes or magnitude changes >30%

rows.Primary Decision: Use frozen IQR scaling from primary complete-case population
rows.Diagnostic / Gate: At least 10 distinct nonsuppressed exposure values
rows.Sensitivity / Withholding Rule: Withhold model interpretation if gate fails
Supportive OLS weighted by aligned ACS adult population, normalized only for numerical convenience

rows.Primary Decision: Treat audited life-expectancy estimates as observed outcomes
rows.Diagnostic / Gate: Audit availability/comparability of SEs or CIs
rows.Sensitivity / Withholding Rule: Precision-weighted sensitivity only when compatible; never replaces OLS

annexes.name: Sensitivity Analyses
annexes.title: Sensitivity and Robustness Analyses
annexes.note: Sensitivity results challenge assumptions; they never replace principal OLS by convenience.

rows.Decision Rule: Do not pool disruption years into primary

rows.Analysis: ≤5% covariate missing: complete case; >5%-20%: MI only with frozen MAR model/predictors/m/transformations/pooling; >20%: compatible alternative or withhold
rows.Decision Rule: Never impute suppressed numerator, outcome, unreliable value, or cross-vintage value

rows.Analysis: Capture restrictions/bands; OLS weighted by aligned ACS adult population
rows.Trigger / Population: Frozen S4 mapping and capture bands
rows.Decision Rule: Weights normalized only for computation; no claim weighting removes selection bias

rows.Analysis: Spatial-error model; rook and connected distance weights
rows.Trigger / Population: Mandatory spatial-error when Moran gate passes
rows.Decision Rule: OLS remains principal; sign change or >20% difference = model-sensitive with equal display

rows.Analysis: Precision-weighted model when comparable life-expectancy uncertainty exists
rows.Interpretation: Dependence on outcome precision; changed estimand

rows.Analysis: Leave-one-area-out and exclude all influence-flagged areas
rows.Decision Rule: No outcome-driven primary exclusion; fragility threshold sign or >30% magnitude change

annexes.name: Multiplicity
annexes.title: Multiplicity and Negative Controls
annexes.note: Families and priorities are frozen before outcome inspection.

rows.Decision: C1 and C2 form one confirmatory family; Bonferroni familywise alpha .05
rows.Required Output: Both estimates with two-sided 97.5% CIs; nominal 95% CIs only as labeled estimation context

rows.Decision: Hypertension and diabetes conditional contrasts are secondary
rows.Required Output: 95% CIs; explicitly secondary and not familywise confirmatory

rows.Decision: BH FDR within each named family only when >1 formal test is reported
rows.Rationale: Separate spatial, annual, comparator, and equity families
rows.Required Output: Family inventory, raw and adjusted P values when applicable

rows.Decision: No promotion based on P value, direction, or visual appeal
rows.Required Output: Exploratory label and full family inventory

rows.Decision: No valid negative control identified; add only before S6 with defensible shared-bias and expected-null rationale
rows.Rationale: Do not manufacture a weak control
rows.Required Output: Conceptual justification or signed 'no valid negative control identified'

annexes.name: Interpretation
annexes.title: Claim and Translation Boundaries
annexes.note: Use the permitted language in manuscript text, figures, captions, and partner-facing materials.

rows.Permitted Language: EHR-diagnosed proportion among observed CAPriCORN adults
rows.Reason: Care-seeking and network observation define denominator

rows.Permitted Language: Higher area diagnosed proportion was associated with a difference in area life expectancy
rows.Prohibited Language: Caused; drove; effect; attributable; preventable years

rows.Permitted Language: Measures differed under distinct ascertainment and target populations
rows.Prohibited Language: Underdiagnosis; overdiagnosis; survey error; poor quality
rows.Reason: Neither comparator is a gold standard

rows.Permitted Language: Can help formulate questions and planning priorities
rows.Prohibited Language: Improved care; optimized allocation; increased access; improved outcomes

rows.Permitted Language: A reproducible model for evaluation in other clinical data research networks
